第146章书山书海，文明观测，匆匆二十载（二合一）
李青山简单逛了逛平台上的建筑，感觉也就是第一眼看着神奇，本质上依旧是死物，也就没了探寻的兴趣。
他没急匆匆朝着那些悬浮的阁楼飞去，而是选择走入了平台上的藏经阁。
李青山进去之后，发现有一佝偻身形的老者，正躺在门口的摇椅上闭眼哼着小曲，神态
要是以前，我一定会转身就跑之类的，可这一次，我一点也不在乎这个报亭老板的猥、琐目光了。
晋升合体期的唐僧依然是有些呆呆的模样，不过比起以前来，倒是机灵了不少。
“你以后也跟他们一样喊我三哥吧，显得亲近。”我侧头看了眼苍蝇，这趟到京城最大的收获就是结识了孔老爷子的几个老战友，摸着兜里那几个“老革命”给的联系方式，我心情说不上的愉悦。
看到我来开门，李芊芊把烟从嘴里面拿出来，她满不在乎地随意按在墙上，那半截烟在冒了两三个烟圈后，彻底暗下去，李芊芊就随手把它扔在地上了。
我根本没想着自己能输，暗想老子今天就豁出去了，非得喝趴下你不可。
胖子满脸认真的沉思几秒钟后，摇摇头说：“柳玥怕热，太阳就不去了。”那架势就好像上月球跟去趟张家界一样简单。
筋脉虽疼，但却还不及洗髓锻体时的一半疼，倒是能忍，却不能表现的不疼，反而要让对方觉得自己中毒极深，已无力反抗。
纳兰天月皱眉，皇后娘娘想杀她办法多的是，有必要一定让太子殿下娶她吗？
一声低喝，他的头顶之上赫然竟凭空出现一条飞流直下的瀑布，那当然不是真正的瀑布，但是那道瀑布，绝对比真正从三千尺高砸下来的瀑布还要可怕。
第146章书山书海，文明观测，匆匆二十载（二合一）
看看貌似正处在深山密林中的自己，似乎二师伯玉鸿布下的传送法阵是随即传送的。
于是，瞬间，所有的道士又都退下了。独孤道长再一次扬起手上的扇子，再一次朝咱们扇动起来。呼呼的风声再一次响起，夹杂着更多的沙石朝着咱们扑面而来。趴下！猴哥大喊一声，于是咱们就勾肩搭背地趴下了。
“漂~~漂亮~~~~”挤出了一个微笑，李风带着条码式的黑线回答到，原本李风还想问一问，柳晴晴是不是向毕加索学过画技，为什么画猫会画出一个四不像，但李风终究还是没有这个胆子开口询问。

就在叶可儿身后，一个身穿紫色长袍，头上长着两只寸许长的肉角的中年人缓缓从扭曲的空间中出现。
“二哥，你找我有事吗？”楚非烟轻轻的问道，她的骄傲与自尊，在他的面前就似乎只剩下了委屈一般。
袁紫玲有些诧异黄梓捷会关心她，却又因为着他的关心，和对她曾经抛弃他而能原谅她，心里有些百感交集。
三道焰光从高空坠下，径直没入三个接近姐弟俩的人类高级战士体内，三人的惨叫声只发出了一秒左右内脏爆裂肚腹炸开立时横死当场。
黎晓霾沒有说话，傻愣地和他们碰着酒杯，傻愣地喝着酒。可为什么，刚才喝着还醇香的酒，此时到了嘴巴，却是一片苦涩。
地狱里面最不缺的应该就是怪物吧，能够无限的重新组构出来，又不断有加入。
李致硕不断的咳嗽，他衬衫上沾的都是血。地面真的是血流成河，我鞋子里都是黏糊糊的。

Chapter 146: A mountain of books and a sea of books, civilized observation, twenty years in a hurry (two in one)
Li Qingshan briefly walked around the buildings on the platform. He felt that they looked magical at first glance, but they were still dead in nature, so he lost interest in exploring.
He did not fly towards the suspended attics in a hurry, but chose to enter the Sutra Pavilion on the platform.
After Li Qingshan entered, he found an old man with a rickety figure lying on a rocking chair at the door with his eyes closed and humming a tune.
If it were before, I would definitely turn around and run away, but this time, I didn't care at all about the obscene and petty look of the newsstand owner.
Tang Seng, who has been promoted to the combined stage, still looks a little dull, but he is much smarter than before.
"You should call me Third Brother like them from now on, to show your closeness." I turned my head and glanced at the fly. The biggest gain from my trip to the capital was getting to know a few of Mr. Kong's old comrades. When I touched the contact information given by the "old revolutionaries" in my pocket, I felt indescribably happy.
Seeing me coming to open the door, Li Qianqian took the cigarette out of her mouth and pressed it on the wall nonchalantly. After two or three smoke rings, the half of the cigarette completely dimmed, and Li Qianqian threw it on the ground.
I didn't even think that I could lose. I secretly thought that I would risk everything today and I would have to drink you down.
After a few seconds of serious contemplation, the fat man shook his head and said, "Liu Yue is afraid of the heat, so the sun won't go out." That attitude was as simple as going to the moon or to Zhangjiajie.
Although the muscles and veins hurt, it was not half as painful as the marrow washing and physical exercise. It was bearable, but it could not be shown that it did not hurt. Instead, it would make the other party feel that they were deeply poisoned and unable to resist.
Nalan Tianyue frowned. The Queen had many ways to kill her. Is it necessary to let the Crown Prince marry her?
With a low shout, a waterfall suddenly appeared out of thin air above his head. Of course, it was not a real waterfall, but that waterfall was definitely more terrifying than a real waterfall falling from a height of three thousand feet.

Looking at himself, who seems to be in a deep mountain forest, it seems that the teleportation circle set up by the second master Boyuhong is teleporting immediately.
So, in an instant, all the Taoist priests retreated. Taoist Master Dugu once again raised the fan in his hand and started fanning towards us again. The whistling wind sounded again, mixed with more sand and stones rushing toward us. Get down! Brother Monkey shouted, so we lay down shoulder to shoulder.
"Pretty~~Beautiful~~~~" Li Feng forced out a smile and replied with a barcode-like black line. Originally, Li Feng wanted to ask whether Liu Qingqing had learned painting skills from Picasso and why he drew four different faces when he painted cats, but Li Feng still didn't have the courage to ask.
Just behind Ye Keer, a middle-aged man wearing a purple robe and two-inch long horns on his head slowly appeared from the twisted space.
"Second brother, do you have anything to do with me?" Chu Feiyan asked softly, her pride and self-esteem seemed to be reduced to grievances in front of him.
Yuan Ziling was a little surprised that Huang Zijie cared about her, but because of his concern and the fact that she could forgive her for abandoning him, she had mixed feelings in her heart.
Three rays of flame fell from a high altitude and went straight into the bodies of three high-level human warriors who were close to the siblings. The screams of the three people only lasted for about a second, as their internal organs exploded and their bellies exploded.Die on the spot.
Li Xiaohao didn't speak. He clinked wine glasses with them and drank the wine stupidly. But why, the wine that was still mellow when I drank it just now tastes bitter when it comes to my mouth.
The most indispensable thing in hell is probably monsters, which can be infinitely reorganized and constantly added to them.
Li Zhishuo kept coughing, and his shirt was stained with blood. The ground was literally covered in blood and my shoes were all sticky.
